description: End-to-end quality control and assurance workflow for telco billing tariffs, from draft creation and validation to approval, deployment, monitoring, and rollback.

tariff_id.description: Unique identifier for a tariff configuration

tariff_version_id.description: Identifier for a specific version of a tariff

qa_session_id.description: Identifier for a QA session running tests on one or more tariff versions

deployment_id.description: Identifier for a specific tariff deployment instance

account_id.description: Customer account identifier used for test scenarios

billing_event.description: Event that triggers billing (e.g., call, data session, SMS)

direction.description: Mobile originated (mo) or mobile terminated (mt) for voice/SMS events

qa_test_case.description: Definition of a single QA test case

expected_charge.description: Expected charge amount for this event

code.description: Internal charge code or GL code

approval_request_id.description: Identifier for an approval request for tariff changes

actor_context.description: Context about who is performing the action and from where.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor in the IAM system.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or organization scope, if applicable.

secret_ref.description: Optional secret reference for signed webhook delivery.

attachment_ref.description: Pointer to an uploaded attachment or document.

pagination.description: Pagination and sorting controls for list endpoints.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor for keyset pagination.

tag_set.description: Free-form key/value tags for categorization and search.

policy_rule.description: Generic policy rule with conditions and actions.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type depends on operator.

functions.name: create_tariff_draft
functions.description: Create a new draft tariff configuration or new version of an existing tariff for QA and approval.

base_tariff_id.description: Existing tariff to clone from; if omitted, creates from scratch

overage_charges.description: Charges applied after included buckets are consumed

metadata.description: Additional information such as owner, tags, etc.

functions.returns: Newly created draft tariff with tariff_id and tariff_version_id.

functions.name: get_tariff_version
functions.description: Retrieve detailed configuration of a specific tariff version for review or comparison.

include.description: Additional sections to include in the response

functions.returns: Complete tariff version configuration including pricing rules, conditions, and metadata.

functions.name: run_tariff_static_validation
functions.description: Perform static validation on a draft tariff version for internal consistency and rule violations before QA execution.

extra_rules.description: Additional ad-hoc validation rules to apply

functions.returns: Validation report including list of issues with severity, affected components, and suggested fixes.

functions.name: create_qa_session
functions.description: Create a QA session grouping multiple tariff versions and test suites to be run together.

tariff_versions.description: Tariff versions included in this QA session

role.description: Role of this version in QA, e.g., control vs experiment

functions.returns: Created QA session with qa_session_id and initial status.

functions.name: add_test_cases_to_qa_session
functions.description: Attach one or more QA test cases or suites to an existing QA session.

test_cases.description: Inline definitions of ad-hoc test cases

functions.returns: Updated QA session summary including total number of test cases attached.

functions.name: execute_qa_session
functions.description: Start or resume execution of a QA session and run billing simulations for all attached test cases.

from_test_index.description: Index of test case to start/resume from

dry_run.description: If true, only validates ability to run without simulation

functions.returns: QA execution status including started_at, estimated_completion, and current progress.

functions.name: get_qa_session_results
functions.description: Retrieve results and metrics for a QA session, including per-test-case outcomes.

include_diff_vs_reference.description: Include comparison vs reference/control tariff results when available

functions.returns: QA session summary, metrics, and optionally paginated per-test-case results with detailed diffs.

functions.name: create_tariff_approval_request
functions.description: Create an approval request for one or more tariff versions after QA completion.

qa_session_id.description: QA session that validated this version

approvers.description: List of approvers and their roles

functions.returns: Created approval request with approval_request_id and current approval status.

functions.name: process_tariff_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an approval or rejection decision for a tariff approval request.

scope.description: Scope of the decision, either full request or specific tariff versions

requested_changes.description: List of requested changes when decision is 'request_changes'

functions.returns: Updated approval status including remaining pending approvers and overall decision.

functions.name: deploy_tariff_version
functions.description: Deploy an approved tariff version to a target environment with rollout controls.

segments.description: For segment_based rollout, defines which customer segments to include

safety_checks.description: Runtime safety checks before finalizing deployment

max_expected_revenue_impact.description: Max allowed projected monthly revenue delta

functions.returns: Deployment request status with deployment_id, current phase, and any pending prechecks.

functions.name: get_deployment_status
functions.description: Get current status and metrics of a tariff deployment, including any anomalies detected.
functions.returns: Deployment status including phase, progress, key metrics, and anomaly indicators.

functions.name: rollback_tariff_deployment
functions.description: Rollback or partially rollback a tariff deployment due to detected issues.

target_percentage.description: For percentage rollback, percentage of users to revert

segments.description: Segments to rollback for segment_based strategy

create_correction_jobs.description: If true, automatically create billing correction jobs for impacted accounts

functions.returns: Rollback status including new deployment state, affected population, and created correction job IDs if any.

functions.name: simulate_billing_for_account
functions.description: On-demand billing simulation for a specific account and tariff version to investigate anomalies or verify fixes.

billing_events.description: List of events to simulate for this account

comparison_baseline.description: Optional baseline to compare results against (e.g., current production tariff)

assume_clean_state.description: If true, ignore historical balances and prior usage

functions.returns: Simulation results including total charge, detailed breakdown, and optional comparison vs baseline.

functions.name: tariff_qa_bulk_import
functions.description: Bulk import tariff qa entities from an external source (CSV, JSON, or upstream system) with validation, mapping, and partial-commit support.

external_query.description: Optional query used to pull records from upstream.

records.description: Inline records, used when source_type is 'json'.

field_mapping.description: Map of source field names to target schema fields.

functions.returns: Bulk import outcome including counts of created/updated/skipped/failed records, per-record errors, and a batch reference.

functions.name: tariff_qa_bulk_update
functions.description: Apply a single update payload across many tariff qa entities matching a filter or explicit id list.

selector.description: How to choose entities for the update.

update.description: Field-level updates to apply. Polymorphic - one of set/unset/append.

functions.returns: Bulk update summary including total matched, updated, skipped (e.g. due to concurrency), and failures.

functions.name: tariff_qa_bulk_delete
functions.description: Soft- or hard-delete (or archive) many tariff qa entities in a single operation with dependency checks.

cascade.description: Whether to cascade to related entities.

include.description: List of relationship names to cascade through.

functions.returns: Bulk delete result including counts of deleted/archived/skipped entities, dependency conflicts, and a tombstone reference.

functions.name: tariff_qa_bulk_export
functions.description: Export tariff qa entities (and optional related data) to a downloadable artifact, optionally redacting sensitive fields.

include_related.description: Names of related collections to include.

field_projection.description: Subset of top-level fields to include.

functions.returns: Export job descriptor including job_id, expected size, status, and delivery details.

functions.name: tariff_qa_search_advanced
functions.description: Faceted, full-text and structured search across tariff qa entities with relevance ranking and facet aggregations.

facets.description: Field names to compute aggregations over.

functions.returns: Search response with ranked hits, total count, facet bucket counts, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: tariff_qa_subscribe_to_events
functions.description: Create a notification subscription for tariff qa events using one or more channels and event-type filters.
functions.returns: Subscription descriptor including subscription_id, enabled status, and validated channel configurations.

functions.name: tariff_qa_list_webhook_deliveries
functions.description: List webhook delivery attempts for tariff qa notifications with filters for status, time window, and subscription.
functions.returns: Paginated list of webhook delivery records including attempt counts, response codes, and last error.

functions.name: tariff_qa_get_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve the audit trail for one or more tariff qa entities with actor, change, and diff information.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events ordered by time with field-level diffs when requested.

functions.name: tariff_qa_schedule_recurring_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring job (e.g. health probe, report generation, sync) related to tariff qa on a cron/interval/calendar schedule.

target.description: Target scope of the job (entity ids and/or filter).

parameters_payload.description: Job-specific parameters passed at each run.

functions.returns: Scheduled job descriptor including job_id, next_run_at, enablement status, and schedule summary.

functions.name: tariff_qa_simulate_operation
functions.description: Simulate a tariff qa operation (e.g. change, deploy, terminate) without committing changes, returning predicted effects and warnings.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot id to simulate against a frozen state.

functions.returns: Simulation report with predicted state diff, dependency impacts, warnings, errors, and cost estimate.

functions.name: tariff_qa_request_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a pending tariff qa change, with reviewers, justification, and SLA.
functions.returns: Approval request record including approval_request_id, status, due_at, and current quorum.

functions.name: tariff_qa_record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approver's decision on a pending tariff qa approval request and advance the workflow.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of this decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval request state including remaining required approvers and whether the request is now finalized.

functions.name: tariff_qa_add_comment
functions.description: Attach a comment, internal note, or @-mention to a tariff qa entity for collaboration.

body.description: Markdown or rich-text body of the comment.

functions.returns: Created comment record including comment_id, created_at, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: tariff_qa_attach_evidence
functions.description: Attach one or more evidence files (logs, screenshots, contracts, diagnostics) to a tariff qa entity.
functions.returns: Attachment registration result with stored attachment IDs, virus-scan status, and any redactions applied.

functions.name: tariff_qa_create_snapshot
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a tariff qa entity (and optionally its dependencies) for restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor including snapshot_id, size, scope manifest, and retention date.

functions.name: tariff_qa_restore_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a tariff qa entity from a previously captured snapshot, with conflict-resolution and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Restore result including restored entity id, conflicts, applied paths, and the resulting state version.

functions.name: tariff_qa_get_kpi_metrics
functions.description: Compute aggregated KPIs and time series for tariff qa activity over a time range, grouped by chosen dimensions.
functions.returns: Aggregated KPI snapshot with per-bucket time series, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: tariff_qa_pin_to_dashboard
functions.description: Pin a tariff qa view, metric, or saved query to an operations dashboard for at-a-glance monitoring.
functions.returns: Created dashboard tile descriptor including tile_id, dashboard_id, and effective configuration.

functions.name: tariff_qa_upsert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a governance/automation policy that applies to tariff qa entities with rule conditions and actions.
functions.returns: Policy descriptor including policy_id, current version, rule count, and validation warnings.

functions.name: tariff_qa_evaluate_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a given tariff qa payload or live entity and return decisions and matched rules.

target.description: Either an entity reference or an inline payload to evaluate.

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report listing decisions (allow/deny/remediate), matched rules, and explanations per rule.

functions.name: tariff_qa_get_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency or association graph for a tariff qa entity, including inbound and outbound links.
functions.returns: Graph response containing nodes and edges up to the requested depth with edge labels and metadata.

functions.name: tariff_qa_manage_links_and_tags
functions.description: Add, remove or replace tags and cross-entity links for a tariff qa entity in a single atomic operation.

links.description: Links to add, remove, or update.

functions.returns: Updated entity reference with applied tag and link changes plus any conflicts encountered.
